definitions.explanation: The state of having enough of something, or the act of making something sufficient. Used for both material needs being met and emotional/spiritual satisfaction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{充足|じゅうそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急務|きゅうむ}→急務：21059_kyuumu⟧だ。
examples.english: Filling staffing needs is an urgent task.

examples.japanese: {充足|じゅうそく}{感|かん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a life full of satisfaction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物質的|ぶっしつてき}→物質的：08739_busshitsuteki⟧な⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧さ⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な{充足|じゅうそく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: It is believed that spiritual fulfillment is important, not just material abundance.

notes:
A formal word describing the state of being sufficiently supplied or fulfilled. Used in both practical contexts (staffing, resources) and abstract contexts (emotional or spiritual satisfaction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {充足|じゅうそく}{感|かん}: sense of fulfillment/satisfaction
- {充足|じゅうそく}{率|りつ}: fulfillment rate, sufficiency rate
- ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{充足|じゅうそく}: staffing sufficiency
- {充足|じゅうそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be satisfied, to be fulfilled

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧: satisfaction — more common in everyday conversation; focuses on contentment with results
- ⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧: fulfillment, enrichment — emphasizes richness and substance of content or experience
- ⟦{補充|ほじゅう}→補充：14037_hojuu⟧: replenishment — the act of restocking or filling up what has been used
